description: Three-axis networking paper taxonomy. Version 3.1 adds explicit unknown labels and missing mechanism categories identified during I.5 review.

scenario.label: Scenario
scenario.description: The network deployment context or domain the paper designs for / operates in

dcn_ai_training.label: DCN AI Training
dcn_ai_training.description: Datacenter networks for distributed AI/ML training workloads (all-reduce, gradient sync, parameter server, MoE training)

dcn_ai_inference.label: DCN AI Inference
dcn_ai_inference.description: Datacenter networks for LLM/ML inference serving (KV-cache distribution, request scheduling, disaggregated inference)

dcn_cloud.label: DCN Cloud
dcn_cloud.description: General cloud datacenter networking: multi-tenant virtual networks, VM/container networking, east-west traffic

dcn_storage.label: DCN Storage
dcn_storage.description: Datacenter storage networking: disaggregated storage, remote memory, NVMe-oF, storage replication

dcn_mixed.label: DCN Mixed
dcn_mixed.description: Mixed or unspecified datacenter context, or a solution that applies across multiple DCN workload types

dcn_general.label: DCN General
dcn_general.description: Datacenter networking without a specific workload focus: general architecture, Clos topology, congestion in DC fabrics

wan.label: WAN
wan.description: Wide-area networks: inter-DC WAN, backbone networks, ISP networks, SD-WAN, traffic engineering across sites

wireless.label: Wireless
wireless.description: Wireless and mobile networks: 5G/6G RAN, cellular core, WiFi, satellite/LEO constellations

interconnect.label: Interconnect
interconnect.description: High-speed interconnects and fabrics: RDMA, NVLink, rack-scale interconnects, host-to-NIC, switch fabrics

edge.label: Edge
edge.description: Edge computing and edge networks: mobile edge (MEC), fog computing, IoT gateways, in-network computing at edge

cdn.label: CDN
cdn.description: Content delivery networks and caching infrastructure: CDN design, caching strategies, video streaming edge

internet_core.label: Internet Core
internet_core.description: Internet-wide infrastructure: inter-domain routing (BGP), RPKI, DNS root, IXPs, global measurement studies

unknown_scenario.label: Unknown / Insufficient Scenario Evidence
unknown_scenario.description: Use only when title/abstract does not provide enough evidence to identify deployment or domain context. This is an explicit uncertainty label, not a topic.

mechanism.label: Mechanism
mechanism.description: The networking mechanism, protocol function, or control action the paper studies or designs

routing.label: Routing
routing.description: Path selection, forwarding decisions, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, etc.), anycast, multicast, route optimization

traffic_engineering.label: Traffic Engineering
traffic_engineering.description: Traffic splitting, load balancing across paths/links, path weight optimization, demand-aware TE

congestion_control.label: Congestion Control
congestion_control.description: Congestion control algorithms, rate adaptation, flow control, TCP/QUIC CC design, BBR, ECN-based CC

flow_scheduling.label: Flow Scheduling
flow_scheduling.description: Packet/flow scheduling, priority queuing, pacing, coflow scheduling, deadline-aware scheduling

resource_allocation.label: Resource Allocation
resource_allocation.description: Bandwidth allocation, buffer management, multi-tenant resource sharing, capacity partitioning, admission control

topology_design.label: Topology Design
topology_design.description: Network topology design: Clos, fat-tree, dragonfly, expander graphs, physical/logical layout optimization

transport_design.label: Transport Design
transport_design.description: Transport protocol design: new transport protocols, transport-layer features (multipath, FEC), connection management

measurement_telemetry.label: Measurement & Telemetry
measurement_telemetry.description: Network monitoring, in-band network telemetry (INT), sketching, performance measurement, troubleshooting

security.label: Security
security.description: Network security mechanisms: DDoS defense, intrusion detection, traffic filtering, network policy enforcement, privacy protection

coordination.label: Coordination
coordination.description: Distributed consensus, state machine replication, coordination protocols, distributed locking, leader election

collective_comm.label: Collective Communication
collective_comm.description: Collective communication patterns: all-reduce, all-to-all, broadcast, reduce-scatter, gradient synchronization

app_scheduling.label: Application-Level Scheduling
app_scheduling.description: Job/task/request scheduling at the application layer: inference request routing, training job placement, co-scheduling

packet_processing_programming.label: Packet Processing & Network Programming
packet_processing_programming.description: Packet-processing pipelines, data-plane programs, network programming languages, parser/match-action composition, packet classification, P4/eBPF/DPDK programs as the main networking function.

dns_naming_resolution.label: DNS / Naming / Resolution
dns_naming_resolution.description: DNS, naming, service discovery, domain registration, resolution behavior, encrypted DNS, DNSSEC, and naming-system measurement or design.

video_qoe_streaming.label: Video / QoE / Streaming
video_qoe_streaming.description: Video streaming, adaptive bitrate, conferencing media transport, QoE measurement or optimization, CDN-assisted media delivery when the paper focus is media quality/streaming behavior.

sensing_localization.label: Sensing / Localization / RF
sensing_localization.description: Wireless/RF sensing, localization, backscatter sensing, activity recognition from wireless signals, and sensor-network signal interpretation.

policy_censorship_economics.label: Policy / Censorship / Economics
policy_censorship_economics.description: Internet censorship, geoblocking, policy enforcement, network neutrality, peering/business behavior, economics of network deployment or operation.

reliability_resilience.label: Reliability / Resilience
reliability_resilience.description: Availability, outages, failover, robustness, resilience to faults or attacks, disaster recovery, and survivability of network services.

experimentation_tooling.label: Experimentation / Testbed / Tooling
experimentation_tooling.description: Experimental platforms, replay frameworks, benchmarking tools, emulation/simulation systems, datasets, and tooling whose main contribution is enabling network experiments or analysis.

unknown_mechanism.label: Unknown / Insufficient Mechanism Evidence
unknown_mechanism.description: Use only when title/abstract does not provide enough evidence to identify the networking mechanism or function. This is an explicit uncertainty label, not a topic.

method.label: Method
method.description: The research approach, technique, or paradigm used (not the problem — the methodology). May be empty for purely empirical/measurement work.

sdn.label: SDN
sdn.description: Software-defined networking: centralized or logically centralized control plane, network operating systems, OpenFlow

programmable_dataplane.label: Programmable Data Plane
programmable_dataplane.description: Data plane programmability: P4, programmable switches, SmartNICs, eBPF/XDP, DPDK, data plane languages

formal_verification.label: Formal Verification
formal_verification.description: Formal methods for networking: network verification (data plane / control plane), model checking, configuration synthesis

virtualization.label: Virtualization
virtualization.description: Network virtualization and abstraction: NFV, network slicing, overlay networks, virtual network embedding

hardware_acceleration.label: Hardware Acceleration
hardware_acceleration.description: Hardware-based acceleration: FPGA offload, switch ASIC design, optical switching, GPU offload for network functions

ml_based.label: ML-Based
ml_based.description: Machine learning applied to solve network problems: RL for network control, DNN for traffic prediction, ML-based anomaly detection

optimization_theoretic.label: Optimization-Theoretic
optimization_theoretic.description: Mathematical optimization or algorithmic approach: LP/ILP formulations, online algorithms with competitive ratios, queueing theory

systems_building.label: Systems Building
systems_building.description: End-to-end system implementation with clear evidence of a concrete prototype, deployment, or production system. Do not use merely because a paper names a system; use only when implementation/deployment evidence is present.

empirical_measurement.label: Empirical Measurement
empirical_measurement.description: Empirical measurement, characterization, dataset analysis, or observational study as the primary research method.

simulation_emulation.label: Simulation / Emulation
simulation_emulation.description: Simulation, emulation, trace replay, or controlled experimental modeling as the primary evaluation/design method.

adding_values.how: Add a new key-value pair under the relevant axis's 'values' object. The key must be snake_case. Provide both 'label' (human-readable) and 'description' (used in LLM prompts — be specific about what distinguishes this from nearby labels).
adding_values.effect: The new value will automatically appear in LLM prompts on the next classification run. No code changes needed.
adding_values.caution: Adding too many similar values increases LLM confusion. If the new value is a subtype of an existing value, consider using it sparingly or as a last-resort split.

stability_note.scenario: Relatively stable. New DCN workload subtypes may emerge (dcn_financial, dcn_hpc, etc.) but expect low churn.
stability_note.mechanism: Relatively stable. The current list covers the main networking functions. Edge cases may need a catch-all mechanism label.
stability_note.method: Designed for incremental growth. New networking research paradigms (e.g., quantum networking hardware, AI-assisted network design) should be added here as they mature.

version_policy.minor: Increment minor version when adding or deprecating values within an axis. Example: 3.0.0 -> 3.1.0.
version_policy.major: Increment major version when adding/removing/renaming axes, or changing the schema structure. Example: 3.x.x -> 4.0.0.

changes: Added unknown_scenario and unknown_mechanism explicit uncertainty labels.
Added missing networking mechanism categories from I.5 review.
Narrowed systems_building and added empirical_measurement/simulation_emulation method labels.
